claims: A food chain is a linear sequence of organisms in which each organism feeds on the one before it and is eaten by the one after it, typically beginning with a producer such as a green plant or alga.

Energy transfer along a food chain is inefficient: roughly 90% of energy is lost as heat and through metabolism at each trophic level, so only about 10% passes to the next level.
